newsitem.title: GERMANY: Nearby N.Europe rapeseed price up in thin trade.
newsitem.headline: Nearby N.Europe rapeseed price up in thin trade.

text.p: Northern European spot rapeseed prices rose in line with firm Chicago soy prices and the strong dollar but turnover was low, brokers said on Friday.
Old crop buyers free Hamburg were at 470 marks for March, having offered 462.50 marks for February last week.
New crop buyers were at 435 marks, down 2.50 on the week.
Brokers said cooperatives and country merchants were increasingly interested in ex-farm contracts.
They also said rape oil traded in Rotterdam after it moved to a discount to soyoil in some months.
While the weak mark supported German seed products, the prospect of ample Latin American soy products meant buyers did not commit themselves to distant months.
Feb/March rapeseed buyers at points other than Hamburg were at 447-470 marks compared with 445-467 quoted last week for old crop.
New crop buyers were unchanged at 430-447 marks, depending on location.
The Matif futures market last showed a May trade at 464 marks, down two, on 98 lot turnover.
Feb rape meal ex Hamburg mills was at 31.50-31.75, off 0.50-0.75 marks per 100 kg, and March/April meal was off 0.25 at 30.25.
German Feb rape oil sellers were at 87.75 and March/April at 88.00 compared with Feb/April at 87.50 last week.
